description: Two NFL teams' head-to-head series since 1999: who leads it, the last ten meetings, straight up, against the spread and over/under, home or road, in the rematch. Without two teams it answers the rivalry spots: division underdogs, dogs in a same-season rematch. Raw record first with n and a 95% interval, then the holds_up test (held-out seasons, false-discovery correction, shrunk estimate). Lists the last ten meetings. For 'do the Packers own the Bears', 'Cowboys Eagles head to head last 10', 'who owns who', 'division rivalry dogs', 'dogs in the rematch', 'Ravens vs Steelers series ATS'.

last_n.description: Only the last N meetings, e.g. 10.

rematch.description: Second (or later) meeting of the same regular season.

team.description: Team: abbreviation, city or nickname, e.g. DAL, Dallas, Cowboys.

name: head_to_head
title: Head to head: who owns who, the series record, and rivalry dogs
